title: Sculpted Castle
description: A multi-tier sculpted keep compiled from rectangular and polygonal massing plans with colossal six-order recessed gate portals, ribbed barrel vaults, projecting pier-buttresses, breaking entablatures, spandrel roses, carved niche walls, arcaded balustrades, ribbed fish-scale domes, dual-LOD instanced parts, and pure procedural TSL relief and glazed-ivory shading.
backend: WebGPU / TSL node materials with GTAO, glare, and dual-LOD instancing
techniques: multi-tier rectangular and polygonal architectural compiler
multi-order recessed arched portals and ribbed vaults
sunk spandrels with inscribed carved roses and niche walls
ribbed fish-scale domes with columned lantern and finials
procedural height-field carved relief with derivative bump LOD
